situations.title: Doosri Danger Raat
body: Speaker phir crackle karta hai. Doosri danger raat. Par is baar naam padhne se pehle hi tum jaan jaate ho — kyunki jo neeche hai, woh tum nahi ho.
Screen pe {ally} ka naam. Sabse kam standing. Aur ghar mein sirf ek banda ke paas itni reach hai ki usse upar kheench sake — tum.
Tumhare paas apni standing hai. Usse spend kar sakte ho — {ally} ko bacha lo, apne kharche pe. Ya khud ko upar rakho, aur usse girne do.

react.text: Arre yaar mera naam neeche aa gaya 😭 tu tension mat le. Sach mein — apne liye khel, mere chakkar mein mat pad.

situations.q: {ally} khatre mein hai. Apni standing kharch karke bachaoge?

reader.text: Raat. Living room. Sab ek line mein khade hain. Speaker on hota hai — doosri danger raat. Aaj kisi ek ka naam sabse neeche hai.
Screen roshan hota hai. Number sabke saamne. Tumhari nazar naam pe padti hai — aur tumhare seene mein kuch girta hai. Woh {ally} hai.
Aye… ye toh main hoon bhai. 😭 Koi na, hota hai. Tu apna khyaal rakh. Seriously — mere liye risk mat lena, tera number bhi safe nahi hai.
Aur tabhi tumhe apni power dikhti hai. Tumhari reach itni hai ki agar tum aaj poora din {ally} ko push karo — reels, tags, story — toh woh bach sakta hai. Par tumhari apni standing girega.
Bachana hai toh apne kharche pe. Apne followers, uski jaan. Ya khud ko upar rakho, aur usse akele girne do. Kya karoge?

choices.t: Usse shield karo — apni standing lagaa do
choices.s: Apne followers ki keemat pe {ally} ko upar kheencho. Dosti pehle.

dm.text: Bhai tune… poora din mujhpe laga diya. 😭
Main dekh raha tha tera number gir raha tha aur tu phir bhi mujhe tag karta gaya. Tune apni jagah ka risk liya. Mere liye. Ye ghar mein koi nahi karta.
Main jokes bahut maarta hoon na, isliye log samajhte hain mujhe kuch farak nahi padta. Aaj padta hai. Tu mera banda hai. Ye main marte dum tak yaad rakhunga. 🔥

choices.t: Khud ko protect karo — usse girne do
choices.s: Apni standing pehle. Danger raat mein sabse pehle khud.

situations.title: {crush} Ka Faisla
body: Danger raat khatam. Ghar so raha hai. Tumhara phone jalta hai — {crush}.
"Terrace pe hoon. Akeli. Agar tum aana chaaho toh… main yahin hoon." Woh nahi keh {p|raha/rahi} ki aao. Woh sirf keh {p|raha/rahi} hai ki darwaza khula hai.
Jo tumne ab tak chuna hai — usne dekha hai. Ab woh apna faisla tum pe chhod {p|raha/rahi} hai. Jaaoge?

react.text: Terrace pe hoon. Akeli. 🥺 Aana chaaho toh aao. Main tumhe majboor nahi kar rahi… bas keh rahi hoon.

situations.q: {crush} terrace pe hai. Jaoge, ya jaane doge?

reader.text: Danger raat ka shor beh chuka hai. Ghar andhere mein doob gaya hai. Tum jaage ho — dil abhi bhi tez chal raha hai. Phone jalta hai.
So gaye kya? Main terrace pe hoon… akeli. Neeche itna drama tha, upar bas hawa hai aur main. 🥺
Dekho, main tumhe force nahi kar rahi. Bas… agar tum aana chaaho, toh main yahin hoon. Aur agar nahi, toh bhi theek hai. ✨
Yeh woh {crush} nahi hai jo camera ke saamne guarded rehti hai. Yeh woh hai jisne apna guard neeche rakha hai — sirf tumhare liye. Aur ise pata hai tumne ab tak kya-kya chuna.
Woh apna faisla tumhare haath mein de rahi hai. Seedhiyaan chadhoge — ya phone neeche rakh ke so jaaoge? Kya karoge?

choices.t: Terrace pe jaao — usse mil lo
choices.s: Seedhiyaan chadho. Isko aur mat taalo.

dm.text: Tum aa gaye. 🥺 Sach mein aa gaye.
Pata hai, main poori raat khud se keh rahi thi — mat bol isko, kya sochega. Par tum aa gaye, bina maine kuch poore se kahe. Toh shayad main akeli nahi thi jo ye mehsoos kar rahi thi.
Yeh ghar sabko ek performance bana deta hai. Us chhat pe, tumhare saath… main sirf main thi. Bohot arse baad. 3 saal baad, shayad. Thank you. ✨

choices.t: Jaane do — phone neeche rakh do
choices.s: Aaj nahi. Sar shaant, dil surakshit.

dm.text: Koi baat nahi. So jao. 🙂
Main thodi der aur baith jaungi yahin. Hawa achhi hai. Tum apna rest lo.
…sach kahun? Ek pal ke liye maine sach mein socha tha ki tum aaoge. Meri galti. Main akele baithne ki aadi hoon waise bhi. Good night. 🥺

situations.title: Ria, Bina Mask
body: 2 AM. Tumhare paas Zoya ke leak kiye screenshots hain — aur unme Ria ka poora sach hai. Woh 2.1M ka glamour udhaar ke paise pe khada hai. Sponsor ka bakaya, brand ki dhamki, sab kuch.
Ek post. Ek expose. Aur subah tak Ria ki poori image — jo image tumhe din 1 se chhoti mehsoos karati rahi hai — sabke saamne toot jaayegi. Followers tumhare paas aa jaayenge.
Ya tum ye screenshots delete kar do. Clean raho. Zoya ki gandagi mein haath na daalo. Faisla tumhara.

reader.text: 2 AM. Sab so gaye. Tumhare phone pe ek folder — Zoya ne bheja. Screenshots. Aur inme Ria ka woh sach hai jo woh 2 saal se chhupa rahi hai.

Ek post — Ria khatam, followers tumhare. Ya screenshots delete — clean haath, chhoti reach. Kya karoge?

reader.text: Late night. Villa chup hai. Finale ko chaubees ghante bhi nahi bache. House ka aakhri content window abhi khula hai — ek slot, prime time, saara internet online.
